highlights: Frost warnings now name the night the cold actually arrives (tonight, tomorrow night or the weekday) instead of usually one night late, and the advisory email's subject shows the advisory's own low
The frost email goes out once per night even when two people have plants in the garden, and both of you see the frost line on Today
Frost warnings no longer count plants that shrug off frost: horseweed, goldenrod, lamb's ear and yarrow
In-ground plants keep their cold card on nights the frost email won't mention them
A Heated checkbox on the location form marks a warm spot like the House, so frost warnings and cold cards skip it
Weather-station alerts now come year-round, at most one a day per problem, including a new one when the outdoor sensors stop reporting
When the rain forecast fails to load, Today says so plainly instead of counting it, and a missing weather icon shows a cloud instead of a sun
